units.source_text: 我只当作寻常的清歌妙舞来欣赏。”

en.t: I simply enjoyed it as ordinary fine singing and graceful dancing.

units.source_text: 源氏中将收到这回信，如获至宝。

en.t: When Lieutenant General Genji received this reply, he treasured it as if he had gained a priceless jewel.

units.source_text: 他想：“她懂得这《青海波》的来历，知道它是唐人的舞乐，足见她对外国朝廷也很关心。

en.t: He thought, She understands the origins of Seigaiha and knows that it is music and dance from Tang China; this clearly shows that she is deeply interested in foreign courts as well.

units.source_text: 这首诗正是皇后的口吻。”

en.t: This poem speaks exactly in the voice of an empress.

units.source_text: 不禁笑逐颜开，便像诵经一般郑重地展读这封回信。

en.t: He could not help breaking into a broad smile, then unfolded and read the reply with the solemnity of chanting a sutra.
